what-must-survive-removing-policy-pins.text: What must survive removing policy pins.

As an integrator, I want to see each existing guarantee, the proposed replacement and the evidence still needed before trusting a registry without pins. This inventory binds the accepted source revision in authority.md. Every candidate claim below is a hypothesis. Accepted declarations, statements, wire formats, application rules and guarantees remain unchanged; hypothetical additions are recorded below. Old definition digests are SHA256 of the complete source-file blob; theorem digests are the base register's statementSha256. A declaration existing or a digest matching proves identity only. The eleven configuration fields are listed individually. The constitution's driver translation still calls config an "eight-field" value, although the bound structure has eleven fields. This discrepancy is recorded in questions.md; its text is not amended here. The proposed four-field datum does not authorize dropping registration cost or booking width.

unavailable-ledger-boundaries.text: The ledger vocabulary ticket remains open; its draft is unaccepted. The history ticket remains open with no matching pull request found. Required vocabulary is unavailable at the base: script-purpose invocation, applied script identity, full ledger values, accepted history, one-shot genesis and spent-at-most-once. These are dependency roles, not invented declaration names, and are excluded from declaration checking. One transaction may invoke two state policies using one spent seed. Across-history spent-once forbids spending it again later; it does not by itself exclude this same-transaction case. Name-only registry binding remains unresolved. No competing ledger layer is introduced.
